description: Ground truth for the synthetic brand tracker demo dataset (docs/workstreams/deck_native/10_brand_tracker_demo_plan.md). All metrics are weighted by 'wt' unless suffixed otherwise. Percentages are 0-100.

significance.method: Two-proportion z-test (pooled) on Kish effective sample sizes n_eff = (sum w)^2 / sum(w^2) of each metric's weighted base; composite and NPS use an unpooled z on weighted means.

definitions.unaided_any_pct: Weighted % of total base with any unaided mention of the brand (unaided_any_<brand>=1). Engine: weighted frequency of code 1 / sum of weighted counts for all codes on total base.
definitions.aided_pct: Weighted % of total base aware of the brand (aware_<brand>=1). Engine: weighted frequency of code 1 / sum of weighted counts for codes 0+1.
definitions.consider_t2b_pct_of_total: Weighted % of total base answering 4-5 on consider_<brand>. Engine: sum weightedCount(codes 4,5) / total weighted base (denominator from aware_<any>=0|1 frequency table).
definitions.consider_t2b_pct_of_answering: Weighted % of valid consideration answers (codes 1-5; DK=98 and structural missing excluded) that are 4-5
definitions.consider_conversion: Alias of consider_t2b_pct_of_answering: consideration conversion among aware brand answerers
definitions.used_p3m_pct_of_total: Weighted % of total base with used_p3m_<brand>=1. Engine: weighted frequency of code 1 / total weighted base.
definitions.pref_share_pct: Weighted % of total base preferring the brand (brand_pref)
definitions.nps.score: Weighted %promoters (9-10) minus %detractors (0-6) among Atlas P3M users, in points
definitions.composite_atlas: Brand health composite: per-respondent mean of (aided awareness, consideration T2B of total, P3M usage), weighted
definitions.attribute t2b_pct_of_answering: Weighted % agreeing (4-5) among valid answers (1-5) for att_<attribute>_atlas; base = aware of brand and gave a rating
definitions.weight_mean: Mean of wt across all respondents in the wave (should be ~1.0 after raking)
definitions.wave5_flattened_mover: Unaided awareness W4->W5 delta (documented in config raw_wave4._comment); significant W3->W4, flat/non-significant W4->W5

files.test_data/fixtures/brand_tracker/brandtr: Raw agency-file variant of W4: same respondents/answers, but no age_band; consideration scale coded in reversed label order (1<->5, 2<->4); att_worth_atlas renamed att_value_atlas and att_worth_beacon renamed att_value_beacon; weight named rim_wt_final with label 'final wt'; junk decoy column body_weight_kg (respondent body weight ~60-110 kg)

storyline_checks.description: Atlas brand health composite up ~4pts W3->W4, significant at 95% weighted
Atlas unaided awareness +~6pts W3->W4 (significant); awareness->consideration conversion flat (not significant)
Beacon overtakes Meridian on consideration T2B (of total) in W4 for the first time in 4 waves
Awareness gain concentrated in Growth segment (code 2) and under-35s; Core flat; exactly one significant segment divergence
Atlas NPS improves W3->W4 but on n~180 users (low-base flag)
W5: Growth-segment unaided gain consolidates (does not fall back); unaided awareness and 'innovative' go flat W4->W5 (previously significant movers stabilise)

non_mover_guard.whitelist_note: planted movers exempt from the stability guard
